From: Alicia Reed <alicia.reed@orionbio.com>

Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Security intake & CAIQ

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for taking this. Orion BioWorks is starting our vendor assessment for Q4 and we need to run through your CAIQ/SIG so our InfoSec team can sign off.

Can we schedule a 30–45 minute intake call next week to go over scope, data residency, logging samples, and temporary access to a staging environment for log collection? We have a short spreadsheet attached with our initial SIG questions filled out (attachment: Orion_SIG_Survey_v1.xlsx).

Also heads-up: our security team will request a high-level SOC 2 summary and any relevant attestations. If there's a central place to download certs or a published compliance page, please point us to it.

Preferred times: Tue/Wed morning PT or Thu afternoon PT.

Technical contact for the call: jon.sullivan@orionbio.com (DevOps)

Best,
Alicia Reed
Head of IT, Orion BioWorks
security@orionbio.com

Hi Alicia — thanks for the note and for the pre-filled survey. Available to run the intake call next Wednesday 10/14 at 10:00 AM PT or Thursday 10/15 at 2:00 PM PT. Which works best?

Quick answers ahead of the call:
- Compliance artifacts: SOC 2 summary and our compliance page are attached (redwood-caiq-reference.pdf).
- Staging access: we can provide a time-limited role for collecting logs; architecture/permissions vary by customer. I will loop in Aditya (infra) to propose the exact access path and a short instruction doc.
- Logging samples: please send 2–3 specific scenarios you'd like captured (ingest, inference, error cases) and we will pull redacted samples.

I'll attach a lightweight staging access checklist (attachment: staging-ssh-instructions.txt) and a calendar invite once you confirm a slot.

Couple of quick asks before the call:
- Can Aditya outline the minimal ACLs / IP allowlist we should open so our DevOps (jon.sullivan@orionbio.com) can validate network access?
